_meta.hard_rule: A fix is 'fixed' ONLY when its full business-chain spec passes end-to-end - never an isolated probe. (B1, 2026-06-09, was falsely declared fixed off a single-insert probe; only the full return->credit->statement->unapply chain exposed the stacked breaks.)
_meta.pass_signal: Every chain is a single DO block that ALWAYS terminates with RAISE EXCEPTION 'SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK'. That exact error text = PASS (and guarantees rollback). ANY other error = FAIL.
_meta.spec_contract: Keys are the primary RPC under test. 'covers' lists every RPC the chain exercises - run-smoke.mjs --spec <rpc> matches keys AND covers entries, so one chain can certify several RPCs. Every migration that touches an RPC must have or extend a spec covering it.

save_quote.description: Drawn-product edit guard (A4): reducing a booking below its drawn quantity and removing a drawn product both raise BOOKING_OVERDRAWN; a legal reduce keeps booked/drawn/status consistent and the booking still closes at the new total; a no-draws control quote edits freely.

rollover_quote_to_season.description: Remainder-only season rollover (A5): 500-booked/200-drawn rolls over exactly 300 with FIFO consumption across split items and acre proration; fully-drawn raises BOOKING_FULLY_DRAWN; no-draws rollover preserves live copy behavior (total_units_needed stays NULL).

auto_expire_quotes.description: Expiry sweep skips partially-drawn bookings past expires_at, still expires an undrawn control quote, completes despite the best-effort activity_feed summary, and re-asserts the 20260609203541 grant hardening (no authenticated/anon EXECUTE).

void_order.description: Draw-ledger reversal on void/cancel: voiding a partial draw order restores the booking balance (re-draw works); cancelling a draw order restores the ledger but preserves the open booking's active hold (F7 skip); voiding the FINAL draw reopens an accepted booking ('booking_reopened' activity) and re-draw re-accepts; whole-conversion void leaves the booking closed; double-void/re-cancel guards hold.

issue_return_credit.description: THE canonical return->credit chain (the B1/B2 class): direct-insert return -> approve_return -> receive_return (restock + inventory txns) -> issue_return_credit (posted credit_memo, credited_by stamped, both audit rows) -> idempotent replay (no double-issue) -> get_customer_statement counts the credit EXACTLY once -> unapply_credit_memo (memo voided, return back to received, total_credit_cents back to 0 NOT NULL) -> statement back to zero -> re-issue works.

draw_down_quote.description: Standard 4-probe auth set, worked example against draw_down_quote: no-auth -> AUTH_REQUIRED; anon-key -> AUTH_REQUIRED with zero rows written; wrong-role (driver/applicator) -> INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; forged p_performed_by -> ACTOR_MISMATCH; plus a positive admin control draw proving the probes failed for the right reason. File header documents the placeholders for adapting it to any new RPC.
